title: League of Legends Patch 26.22 Notes
description: Patch 26.22 is at the top of the charts. K/DA is starting fires, Mel got a midscope, and plenty of changes are in for SR, Mayhem, and Classic.

title: League of Legends Patch 26.20 Notes
